description: First-time input MMIO UART: APB4 slave, one level interrupt source and a two-wire external pin pair.

resets.release: RTL asserts reset asynchronously on negedge rst_ni; release must satisfy clk_i recovery/removal timing.

interrupts.hold: irq_o stays high while IRQ_STATUS[0] is set and CTRL[1] enables the interrupt.
interrupts.clear: Write 1 to IRQ_STATUS[0] (offset 0x10); reading RXDATA only clears the receive-valid state, not the interrupt latch.

semantics: Register map, byte offsets and side effects were read from examples/soc_generation/rtl/novauart.sv.
APB4 access attributes come from src/myfuzz/protocols/plugins/apb4.json.
pready_o is tied high, so every accepted APB transfer completes in the first ACCESS cycle; pslverr_o is driven for offsets outside the documented register map.

Optional register declarations added for the generated software phase: reset_value is the register's post-reset value (ctrl_q resets to 0); writable_bits is the mask the RTL really stores, because the register is declared 32 bits wide while the RTL keeps ctrl_q[7:0] and irq_pending_q (bit 0 only); clears_register names the declared register whose value proves a clearing access took effect (writing 1 to IRQ_STATUS[0] clears irq_pending_q, which IRQ_STATUS itself exposes). RXDATA declares no clears_register: novauart.sv clears rx_valid_q on a RXDATA read, and no declared register exposes rx_valid_q, so the generator records that as a coverage note instead of inventing a probe.
verified: Physical ports and widths come from verilator elaboration of the pinned novauart.sv.
APB behaviour is a direct implementation of the documented register decode; no independent bus-level run evidence exists yet.
unknown: UART serial framing (baud rate, stop bits) is not modelled and is not claimed.
